buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TENDER DOCUMENTS Subject – Enquiry for providing manpower services for Mess / Canteen, house keeping of BHEL office and office assistance at Talcher site office for a period of 01 year regarding.

Tender Ref. No - : BHEL/PW/TLR-HR-Menial-2026 Dated 12.11.2 026 Date of publication of the Tender : 12.11.2026 Last Date of BID Submission : As per GeM Portal Date of Opening of Technical BID : As mentioned in Tender Documents Date of Opening of Price BID : As mentioned in Tender Documents Bids are invited through the GeM portal from interested bidders for the subject as per “Annexure – I”. The foll owing points relevant to the tender may please be noted and complied with. Interested vendors may submit suitable offers in the prescribed formats as per the following terms and conditions on GeM Portal: Scope of Work: Supply of manpower services for Mess / Canteen, housekeeping of BHEL office a nd office assistance at Talcher site office for a period of 01 year regarding. The agency is required to deploy 16 personnel, of which 5 will be skilled and 11 will be unskilled. These perso nnel will be assigned to office assistance, housekeeping, and other miscellaneous tasks in the BHEL office as per BHEL’s requirements. The agency shall also provide additional manpower at the agreed rates, terms, and conditions if required by BHEL during the contract period. Location of services will initially be at the BHEL office at Talcher site. Qualifying Criteria: 1. The vendor should possess a valid PAN Card. 2. The vendor should be registered on the GeM portal. 3. The vendor should have GST registration. 4. The vendor should be registered with the Provident Fund (PF) authority. 5. The vendor should be registered with the Employee State Insurance Corporation (ESIC). 6. The vendor should have experience of minimum 3 years of manpower supply. 7. The vendor should have turnover of Rs. 50 Lakh in one financial year in last 7 years. Contract Period: The contract will initially be for 1 year from the date of execution. The same can be extended for further one year with mutual consent and same terms and condition and rates. Liquidated Damages: 1. The vendor must provide the required manpower for deployment at the BHEL site office for menial services. A penalty of Rs. 1000/- per day will be imposed if the agency fails to provide the required manpower within th e first 15 days of the stipulated period. If the agency still fails to complete the work within the extended perio d, the contract will be considered canceled without further notice or communication. 2. The agency must pay Central Minimum Wages in accordance with the New Wages Code 2019. 3. The agency must comply with statutory obligations such as Provident Fund (PF), ESIC, Bonus, etc., in accorda nce with prevailing labor laws. If the agency fails to meet statutory compliance, the amount will be deducted f rom their bills and paid to the respective statutory agencies along with penalties. If there are changes in wag es or statutory requirements, the agency must pay the revised amounts. Enhanced wages and subsequent st atutory compliances due to increased wages will be paid by BHEL to the agency.

Termination Clause: 1. The contract can be terminated by either party by providing a 30-day prior written notice without specifying any reason. Billing Cycle and Documents: 1. Billing to be done monthly basis. 2. The bidder shall be required to submit the copy of following documents along with monthly bill – 1. Copy of Master roll for employees deployed 2. Copy of Wages register. 3. Copy of Wages Slip. 4. Copy of other Registers under the New Labour Codes effective from 21.11.2025 as applicable 5. Copy ECR of PF and ESIC 6. Copy of PF and ESIC Challan 7. Copy of attendance and Leave record of the month. 8. Copy of GST Receipt. Terms of Payment 1. The successful bidder shall submit the bill/invoice on monthly basis plus Service Charge along with any other bills as per tender terms and conditions), which shall be duly verified, checked by concerned BHEL Official for releasing of payment. 2. All payment shall be made in Indian currency and by RTGS/NEFT only. 3. Paying Authority: Head/Finance, BHEL-PSWR, Talcher. 4. No Advance shall be paid by BHEL. 5. The payment shall be made in Indian currency only by Account Payee cheque /RTGS. Payment will be made on monthly basis and it will be released within 30 (Thirty) days after receipt of bill. 6. Please Note, GST portion of invoice shall be released only upon: - GST will be reimbursed to the vendor on pr oduction of documentary evidence of filing returns, visible in the GST portal for claiming Input Tax Credit by BHEL 7. TDS & GST will be applicable as per the prevailing rules. If there are any changes in TDS or GST rules, the ve ndor will be required to comply. 7. L1 Criteria: 1. L1 will be decided based on the profit margins quoted by the agency in the price bid format. As the other fact ors are fixed. Order will be issued including all the factors such as GST, margin etc. 2. If multiple bidders have the same L1 status, effective L1 will be decided by soliciting discounts from the resp ective bidders. 3. In case multiple bidders still have the same L1 status after discounts, the L1 bidder will be chosen through a toss or draw of lots in the presence of the respective bidders or their representatives. 4. Ranking will be done accordingly. BHEL's decision in such situations will be final and binding. 5. There will be no counter-offer.

Other Terms and Conditions: 1. No advance payment will be made. Payment will be made on submission of monthly bills after satisfactory c ompletion of the work. 2. The agency shall submit a monthly bill in triplicate, covering the period from the 1st to the last day of each m onth, within 15 days of the following month. Interim bills will not be accepted. Payment will be made through ECS within 30 days of bill submission, subject to TDS deduction as per the provisions of the Income Tax Act. 3. Bid Offer validity will be 90 days. 4. Deployment of manpower will only be made with the consent of BHEL. No deployment of manpower will be c onsidered if carried out without the consent of BHEL. 5. The agency must pay wages to the manpower only through online mode, as per the prevailing central minim um wages. Wages will be regulated according to the latest circular of central minimum wages and the NTPC Circular at the Talcher site. All statutory compliances will be based on the payments made by the agency. 6. Any other labour law like Bonus, Workmen compensation/employee compensation may be applicable as per prevailing labour law rules. 7. The bidder must submit the tender on the GeM portal as per “Annexure I.” The tender should be signed by th e authorized person. Overwriting in tender documents will not be accepted, and all signed documents must b e uploaded on the GeM portal for further evaluation. 8. The agency is responsible for processing the gate pass for the manpower and must arrange all required docu ments for issuing entry passes. 9. The agency has to stamped and signed each page of contract including Confidentiality Clause No deviati on clause, Declaration of not - Blacklisting and Indemnity Clause. 10. Bidders should carefully study the tender documents and conditions before quoting their bid. All pages of the tender form must be signed by the bidder as a token of acceptance. No relaxation in terms and conditions wil l be granted afterward. 11. The bidder must submit self-attested copies of the following documents along with the tender: · PF Registration Certificate · ESI Registration Certificate · GST Certificate · PAN Card 12. Rates must be indicated both in words and figures. In case of a discrepancy between the figure (number) and words, the rates in words will be considered authentic, and no further clarification will be sought. 13. Any updates on important dates, amendments, clarifications, or modifications to the tender specification will be communicated separately through GeM Portal. 14. The vendor must deduct the necessary amounts towards PF/ESIC and contribute an equal amount as per the Government of India laws. These amounts will be deposited regularly with the concerned authorities. BHEL m ay require submission of documents as evidence. 15. BHEL may request proof of regular payments to the manpower and may verify relevant records for complianc e with statutory requirements. The agency must enable BHEL to access these facilities without delay or excus es. 16. The unit of measurement for services rendered satisfactorily by one person during one month will be termed as one "service month." Total mandays will be calculated for 26 days in a month. Payment will be made base d on the service month rate quoted by the bidder on a pro-rata basis. 17. Personnel deployed must be healthy, active, and not less than 18 years of age, with no communicable diseas es.

18. The contractor must pay wages to personnel on or before the 7th day of every succeeding month, regardless of any delay in payment by BHEL. Wages should be at least the minimum wages as declared by the compete nt authority. 19. The agency must maintain all statutory records and documents as prescribed under relevant Acts/Rules and f ile all prescribed returns in the proper format. All statutory documents must be submitted with the monthly b ill. BHEL reserves the right to withhold payments if the agency fails to provide these documents regularly. 20. There will be no request for variations in quoted rates or withdrawal of tender after submission. 21. Counter terms and conditions or changes in the format will not be accepted. 22. Income Tax TDS will be deducted as per applicable rules. 23. BHEL management reserves the right to cancel the contract at any time by providing one month's notice. 24. BHEL reserves the right to reject any bid (including the lowest) if it is deemed non-responsive or violating the conditions/specifications, without any liability for any loss caused to the bidder. 25. BID shall be submitted through GeM Portal only. Bid received through any other mode will not be considered in any case. 26. The nature of required services can not be split hence Purchase preference can not be given to MSE Mode & Schedule of Submission of Bids: 1. Bids must be submitted through the BHEL GeM portal only. No other submission mode will be accepted. 2. Submitted offers will be opened as per scheduled mentioned in the BHEL GeM portal Tender Documents. Bids will be evaluated based on the documents submitted, and the lowest quoted bidder will be decided based on the margin quoted in the prescribed price bid format. Confidentiality Clause The agency shall maintain the confidentiality of all documents, data, and information provided b y BHEL during the tenure of the contract and after its completion. Any breach of confidentiality will lead to penalties and termination of the contract. Authorised Signatory Indemnity Clause The agency agrees to indemnify and hold BHEL harmless from any and all claims, damages, losse s, and expenses arising from the contractor’s failure to comply with the contract terms, labor la ws, statutory obligations, or any wrongful act by the agency or its employees. Authorised Signatory

No Deviation Clause The agency hereby agrees that the contract shall be execute d strictly in accordance with the terms and conditions specifi ed in the Tender/Work Order/Agreement. No deviation, modif ication, or alteration in scope of work, number of manpower, category of manpower, wages, statutory compliance, or any other contractual condition shall be permitted during the con tract period, unless expressly approved in writing by BHEL. Any attempt by the agency to impose its own terms and con ditions or deviate from the agreed terms shall render the con tract liable for termination and other actions as deemed appr opriate by BHEL. Authorised Signatory Declaration of Non-Blacklisting The agency declares and confirms that it has not been blackli sted, banned, or debarred by any Central/State Government Department, Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), Autonomous B ody, or Private Organization at the time of submission of the bid/award of the contract. In case the declaration is found to be false or misleading at a ny stage during the contract period, BHEL reserves the right to terminate the contract immediately.
